purpose: Make the validated support-oracle result a fail-closed prerequisite for native exact-CMLE inference readiness while preserving optimizer, estimate, likelihood, covariance, WLE, MnSq, and display-precision evidence as separate layers.

integration_contract.default: The repository-only fit_cmle route enables the finite-MLE gate by default; an explicit false option exists only for controlled backward/numerical comparison and is recorded in config and summary.
ordering: strict eligibility and exact prefit rank
unchanged exact optimizer and finite-domain remediation
integration_contract.readiness: InferenceReady is true only when the support oracle returns interior_finite_cmle_supported with ExistenceQualified=true and all existing optimizer/final-rank/covariance/stationarity gates pass.
integration_contract.boundary: A boundary fit may retain finite technical optimizer outputs for reproducibility, but InferenceReady is false and ReadinessReasons includes finite_mle_boundary_no_finite_cmle.
integration_contract.unavailable: Oracle failure, tolerance instability, cap, or directional-verification failure sets InferenceReady=false with a typed finite_mle_<status> reason; it is never treated as interior.
integration_contract.telemetry: Summary, config, and returned audit retain gate-enabled state, existence status/reason, boundary flag, tolerance grid, theoretical configurations, oracle state cells, generated cuts, and oracle calls.
integration_contract.no_fit_substitution: The gate does not clip estimates, add a penalty/prior, modify MnSq, or silently switch estimator.

registered_checks.synthetic_boundary: Every prefit-eligible registered complete-separation/boundary fixture that returns a technical fit is non-ready under the default gate even when optimizer convergence, finite-point rank, or gradient would otherwise pass.
registered_checks.synthetic_interior: Every registered interior fixture retains its prior optimizer/readiness result and is marked existence-qualified.
registered_checks.fail_closed_mock: A deliberately injected unavailable/tolerance-unstable oracle result with otherwise successful optimization cannot become inference-ready.
registered_checks.explicit_comparison_off: The explicit gate-disabled path records not_evaluated and reproduces the pre-integration technical fit/readiness behavior; it is not the default.
registered_checks.retained_replay: All same-byte 287 prefit-eligible connectivity cases return; 274 interior cases remain ready and 13 boundary cases remain non-ready with the new typed reason.
registered_checks.numeric_invariance: Against the finite-domain remediation evidence, common returned rows preserve structural estimates, SE, conditional log likelihood, WLE, Infit, Outfit, and raw/rounded decisions within the previously registered binary64 comparison tolerances.
registered_checks.floating_point: Existence uses the frozen tolerance grid and normalized support rows; fit classes continue to use raw MnSq and display rounding cannot affect readiness.

success_gates.retained_readiness: 274/287, all and only oracle-interior cases that pass existing numerical gates
success_gates.boundary_withheld: 13/13 retained boundary cases and every returning synthetic boundary control are non-ready
success_gates.interior_preservation: Zero retained interior readiness regressions relative to existing numerical gates
success_gates.tests: All selected CMLE, hard-anchor, WLE-fit, and existence tests pass, including new integration controls.

interpretation_limits.technical_boundary_outputs: A retained large finite estimate on a boundary is optimizer evidence only and must not be reported as a finite unpenalized CMLE.
interpretation_limits.anchors: An interior result is conditional on fixed anchors and does not validate their origin or differential accuracy.
interpretation_limits.fit: Existence-qualified readiness does not validate MnSq thresholds, local independence, fairness, or bias.
interpretation_limits.cross_engine: No claim of identical boundary handling with immer, TAM, sirt, or mfrmr is made.
interpretation_limits.public_ui: withheld pending staged explanation and cross-engine boundary review
